source.title: Pantheon (Rome)
source.author: Wikipedia contributors
source.verified_note: HTTP200；正文命中 'originally built under Roman emperor Augustus (27 BC–AD 14) and reconstructed under Hadrian (117–138)'、'coffered concrete dome made from Roman concrete'、'43 metres (142 ft)'、'Since AD 609, it has served as the Roman Catholic Basilica'

body_rewrite: 万神殿位于意大利罗马，最初建于奥古斯都时期（公元前27年—公元14年），哈德良时期（117—138年）重建；其穹顶以罗马混凝土筑成，至天窗的高度与内部圆形直径同为43米，是迄今最大的无筋混凝土穹顶，自公元609年起用作天主教堂。

source.title: Fall of the Western Roman Empire
source.author: Wikipedia contributors
source.verified_note: HTTP200；正文命中 'In 476, the Germanic barbarian king Odoacer deposed the last emperor of the Western Roman Empire in Italy, Romulus Augustulus' 与 'the Senate sent the imperial insignia to the Eastern Roman emperor Zeno'

body_rewrite: 西罗马帝国通常以476年为终点：这一年日耳曼国王奥多亚塞废黜了在意大利的末帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都，元老院将帝国徽记送交东罗马皇帝芝诺。

source.title: Romanesque architecture
source.author: Wikipedia contributors
source.verified_note: HTTP200；正文命中 'massive quality, thick walls, round arches, sturdy pillars, barrel vaults'、'small windows of early Romanesque'、章节标题 'Groin vault'

body_rewrite: 罗马式建筑以厚重的墙体、半圆拱、粗壮墩柱和筒形拱为典型特征，早期实例可见小窗；其拱顶形式包括筒形拱与十字拱（groin vault）。

罗马式艺术与哥特式艺术之间的过渡关系

source.title: Gothic architecture
source.author: Wikipedia contributors
source.verified_note: HTTP200；正文命中 'in the twelfth century from preceding Romanesque building traditions'、'overlapped with Romanesque in Transitional or Romano-Gothic styles'、章节 'Romanesque influence'

body_rewrite: 哥特式建筑于12世纪由先前的罗马式建筑传统发展而来，二者之间存在被称为「过渡式」或「罗曼—哥特式」的重叠阶段，说明罗马式向哥特式的转变并非突然断裂。

source.title: Early Christian art and architecture
source.author: Wikipedia contributors
source.verified_note: HTTP200；正文命中 'identifiably Christian art only survives from the 2nd century onwards'、'After 550, Christian art is classified as Byzantine'

body_rewrite: 可辨识的基督教艺术实物自2世纪起留存，约550年以后的基督教艺术通常归入拜占庭艺术，因此早期基督教艺术大致对应2至6世纪。

source.title: Early Christian art and architecture
source.author: Wikipedia contributors
source.verified_note: HTTP200；正文命中 'Among the motifs adopted were the peacock, Vitis viniferavines, and the "Good Shepherd"'、'such symbols as the fish (ikhthus) were not borrowed from pagan iconography'

body_rewrite: 早期基督教艺术既借用异教图像（如孔雀、葡萄藤与「好牧人」），也发展出自身象征体系，其中鱼（ikhthus）即为代表性符号。
